RAPE
Introduction
“Physically forced or otherwise coerced penetration – even if slightly – of the vulva or anus, using a penis, other body parts or an object” (WHO 2003). A growing social disorder afflicting the poor and rich, alike, with devastating and longstanding emotional consequences for the afflicted, family and society at large.

Risk factors
- Mental illness
- Alcohol and drug abuse
- Neglect and inattentiveness to the needs of the girl-child
